description: Use this when a buyer wants the differences between two exact padel-racket models whose catalogue slugs are known. Resolve ambiguous model names and years first. Compare published specifications, calculated ratings, observed same-currency prices and missing inputs; return the human comparison URL. Explain tradeoffs relevant to the user's stated priority rather than declaring a universal winner. It cannot establish live availability or medical suitability. Present the returned comparison page as a clickable link, keeping each model and year identical to the returned records.
name: compare_rackets
title: Compare two exact models
